propositions: The parent-first cascade logic is duplicated in claim.py and transition.py, with identical ghost/init preconditions but different edge support capabilities
A new shared module lifecycle_cascade.py extracts only the walk (ancestor recursion, cycle guard, TOCTOU re-check, error rewrap) while decision table _CASCADING_EDGES remains at transition.py:415

The cascade operates on three edges (open→in_progress, closed→open, closed→in_progress) but claim can only express open→in_progress, requiring injected resolve_parent and advance closures to parameterize the walk
The cascade must preserve ConcurrencyMismatch exceptions and exit code 10 at the leaf, and benign-race re-checks must prevent false failures when parents are claimed by other sessions
All three cascading edges must continue working after consolidation, with reopen already cascading via the (closed→open) row and * → closed still not cascading
